target_demo: 20s-40s adults managing personal credit; loan-considering consumers who don't know their credit grade
narrative_arc: Demonstration to question to solution: an abstract 3D credit gauge shows how a credit grade maps to a loan interest rate (good grade = low rate, poor grade = high rate), a full-screen blue card asks the viewer their own grade as a hook, the app composite then reveals the free check/diagnose/manage service with a real credit screen, and the film closes on the centered brand logo.
creative_device: abstract data-viz gauge as risk-to-safety metaphor, then question hook, then app-UI proof and CTA

production_signature.signature_note: Three visual registers composited: a 3D-rendered credit speedometer (cut1), a flat brand-blue kinetic-typography card (cut2), a split brand-copy + phone app-UI demo (cut3), and a centered logo end card (cut4). No global wiggle/parallax — metrics mean_abs_shift_x 0.53 with low sign-flip ratio 0.107 confirm a locked-off, graphics-driven piece.

global_layout.layout_note: Cuts 1, 2 and 4 are centered single-focus compositions (gauge / question / logo) with wide margins; cut 3 breaks into a left-right vertical split — a brand-and-copy zone on the left and a phone showing the app credit screen on the right.

copywriting.copy_strategy: Make an invisible number (credit grade) concrete via a speedometer metaphor, pose it as a personal question, then resolve with a free, all-in-one app service.

recreation_prompts.t2i_start_frame: A clean, minimal financial data-visualization key frame rendered as a polished 3D motion-graphics still, set on a softly lit near-white studio background in pale cool grey (#eef1f5) carrying a faint top-to-bottom gradient and a gentle vignette that keeps the corners slightly darker than the center. Centered in the upper-middle of a 16:9 landscape frame sits a large semicircular speedometer-style credit gauge: an open arc spanning roughly two hundred degrees, its tube-like body rendered with smooth three-dimensional thickness, soft rounded end caps, gentle specular highlights along the top edge and a faint soft contact shadow beneath it. The arc carries a continuous left-to-right color gradient that travels from a warm coral red (#e8455f) on the left, through a magenta-violet midpoint at the top, into a vivid cobalt blue (#2f80ed) on the right, reading unmistakably as a risk-to-safety spectrum. At the geometric center of the arc a brushed chrome-grey needle indicator, metallic and slightly beveled, pivots from a small circular hub and points toward the right-hand blue zone, casting a small soft drop shadow onto the pale surface to reinforce depth and separation from the background. Directly below the gauge two numeric readouts sit side by side in a clean bold Korean rounded sans-serif: the left column shows a small grey label 신용등급 with a large charcoal 2등급 beneath it, and the right column shows a small grey label 대출금리 with a large charcoal 4 % beneath it, all in near-black charcoal (#33363a) for crisp legibility against the bright field. In the lower-right corner a small light-grey fine-print citation line reads 2019년 5월 전국은행연합회 자료 기준. The composition is centered and symmetrical with generous negative space surrounding the single hero dial, a quiet single-focus infographic layout with nothing else competing for attention. Lighting is soft, high-key and almost shadowless: a broad diffused frontal key at a neutral 5500K color temperature, abundant fill because the background is already luminous, no rim light, and only the faint contact shadows under the dial body and needle to suggest a hair of dimensionality. The lens read is flat and orthographic, as if a 50mm-equivalent view looks straight onto a flat motion-graphics plane at eye level with no perspective distortion or converging verticals. The color strategy pairs a desaturated cool background with a single high-saturation red-to-blue arc that owns nearly all of the chroma in frame, while charcoal numerals act as luminance anchors and a split warm-cool temperature contrast quietly dramatizes the good-versus-bad reading. Textures are smooth matte plastic on the gauge body, brushed metal on the needle, clean flat vector type on the labels, and a soft paper-like matte field in the background with no film grain. The atmosphere is calm, clinical and trustworthy, with no haze, particles, smoke or atmospheric effects of any kind. The post and signature look is clean digital 4K commercial motion graphics with crisp anti-aliased edges, gentle ambient occlusion where the dial meets the ground plane, and an uncluttered brand-forward finish. Style anchor: Korean fintech explainer-ad aesthetic, a flat-meets-3D infographic look, hi-key product-neutral studio, absolutely no people present; this still is the start state of an animated sweep in which the needle will rock between a good grade and a poor grade while the paired numerals increment.

recreation_prompts.t2i_start_frame: A bold, declarative full-screen typographic title card filling a 16:9 landscape frame edge to edge with a single solid, saturated royal-blue field in a vivid Toss-like cobalt (#1a56f0), perfectly flat with no gradient, no texture and no vignette, the color owning the entire background as a confident brand statement. Centered slightly below the vertical midpoint sits one line of large Korean type reading 당신의 신용등급은 ? set in a heavy rounded sans-serif, the glyphs a soft near-white with the faintest cool tint (#eaf0ff) so they glow gently against the blue without harsh pure-white clipping; the question mark is spaced a little apart at the end, giving the line a calm, conversational cadence as if the brand is speaking directly to one viewer. The type is horizontally centered with comfortable margins left and right, and a large expanse of empty blue above and below it, the negative space doing real work to make the single question feel important and unhurried. There are no other graphic elements in frame: no logos, no icons, no decorative shapes, no UI, no people, no props, nothing but the field of blue and the white question. Lighting is irrelevant in a literal sense because this is flat motion-graphics color, but render it as perfectly even digital fill with absolutely uniform luminance across the entire blue plane, no hot spots, no falloff toward the corners, and no cast shadows behind the letters, keeping the surface clean and screen-native. The lens read is a straight-on flat composition with no perspective and no depth, the type sitting exactly on the picture plane. The color strategy is deliberately monochrome and maximal: one dominant high-saturation brand blue plus a single near-white for the text, a pure luminance contrast that is instantly legible and unmistakably on-brand, with the white reading as roughly fifteen percent of the frame area. Texture is none — smooth flat vector type on smooth flat color, the cleanest possible digital surface, no grain, no paper, no noise. Atmosphere is none: this is a graphic interstitial, not a photographic scene, so there is no haze, dust, glow or particle of any kind. The post and signature look is crisp, anti-aliased, modern app-marketing minimalism, the kind of confident single-color question card that punctuates Korean fintech short-form ads between a demo and a product reveal. The single line of type is optically centered rather than mathematically centered, nudged a touch above the true middle so the large empty lower half of the blue field feels intentional and balanced, and the weight of the glyphs is heavy enough to hold presence against the saturated field without tipping into shouting. The spacing between 당신의, 신용등급은 and the trailing question mark gives the line a measured, conversational rhythm, as if a friendly teller were leaning in to ask a single direct question, and the soft near-white tint keeps the address warm rather than clinical. Nothing animates in this still; it is a calm, confident pause in the edit, a deliberate breath of pure brand color and one human question between the explanatory gauge that precedes it and the product proof that follows. Style anchor: brand-forward kinetic-typography interstitial, full-bleed brand blue, one Korean question in soft white, total simplicity, no imagery; this still is the held state of the card just before the next composition (a smartphone showing the app) begins sliding in horizontally from the left edge to replace it.

inferred_creative_thinking.insight: Most people don't know their own credit grade and don't realize it directly sets the interest rate they pay on loans.
inferred_creative_thinking.persona: A young-to-mid adult who is vaguely anxious about money and loans but has never checked their credit grade because it felt opaque or paid.
inferred_creative_thinking.moment: The second the speedometer needle swings from a good grade to a bad grade and the rate jumps from 4% to 10%, making the cost of a low grade viscerally clear.
inferred_creative_thinking.product_role: Toss turns an invisible, intimidating number into a free, one-tap check with diagnosis and ongoing management inside an app they already trust.
inferred_creative_thinking.punchline: Your credit grade isn't a mystery and it isn't paid — check it free in Toss.
inferred_creative_thinking.differentiator: Free check plus diagnose-and-manage in one place, framed with a clean speedometer metaphor instead of dry tables.
inferred_creative_thinking.brand_fit_one_liner: Toss makes a scary financial number feel simple, free and friendly.

inferred_brief: Drive awareness and trial of Toss's free credit-rating check by making an invisible number (credit grade) feel concrete and consequential, then resolving it with a free all-in-one app service.
analyst_notes: 15s Toss credit-rating service ad, motion-graphics + app-UI demo, no human subjects. 4 cuts: (1) 3D speedometer credit gauge animating between 2등급/4% and 9등급/10%; (2) full-screen blue hook card '당신의 신용등급은 ?'; (3) split brand-copy + phone app demo with CTA '신용등급 무료조회'; (4) centered logo end card. scenedetect found 3 scenes (it merged cut2-3 across the gradual slide); metrics flagged the slide boundary at f246/8.21s, so shot_count_corrected = 4. No global wiggle (mean_abs_shift_x 0.53). Year 2019 inferred from on-screen data citation. Whisper raw '무려조해' corrected to '무료조회' against captions.
